effective jump below the computed threshold: no detection
jump mathematically equal to the effective threshold: strict > result

source_defect.required_future_guard: future SPMKit production must reject xres < 2 or otherwise prevent the invalid first-candidate access
source_defect.root_cause: for xres=1 the source minimum length truncates to zero, so every row can become a boundary candidate; the first candidate causes construct_blocks' second segment evaluation to move one row before the allocated field (row -= xres) and process_one_step_segment reads d[-1]
